name: eaBreakeven
summary: This EA is a breakeven utility that automatically moves the stop loss of open positions to the breakeven point once price moves a specified number of points in profit. It does not open its own trades but manages existing positions to lock in risk-free trades.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个保本工具，当价格朝盈利方向移动指定点数后，自动将持仓的止损移至保本价位。它不自行开仓，仅管理现有持仓以锁定无风险交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是保护已有浮盈，当市场价格朝持仓方向有利移动达到用户设定的点数阈值后，将止损调整至开仓价格（保本点）加上可选的小额偏移量。入场条件不适用，因为此EA不执行开仓操作。出场条件由移动止损至保本价位来管理，确保持仓不会转为亏损。仓位管理和资金管理也不适用，因为EA不涉及开仓或调整仓位大小。其核心逻辑是遍历所有符合条件的持仓（按MagicNumber和品种过滤），计算当前浮盈点数，若超过阈值则调用OrderModify将SL移至保本价。该工具适用于所有时间周期，因为它是基于点数阈值而非价格结构来触发操作的。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is to protect existing floating profit by moving the stop loss to the breakeven point once price moves favorably by a user-defined number of points. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not execute trade openings. Exit management is handled by modifying the stop loss to the breakeven level, ensuring the position cannot turn into a loss. Position sizing and money management are not applicable as the EA does not open or adjust position sizes. Its core logic iterates through all qualifying positions (filtered by MagicNumber and symbol), calculates the current floating profit in points, and if it exceeds the threshold, calls OrderModify to move SL to breakeven. This tool is applicable to all timeframes since it operates on a point threshold basis rather than price structure triggers.

parameters.name: BreakevenPoints
parameters.description: 触发保本操作所需的盈利点数阈值
parameters.description_en: Break-even trigger profit threshold in points

parameters.name: BreakevenOffset
parameters.description: 保本止损与开仓价的偏移点数（可加几点评利）
parameters.description_en: Break-even stop loss offset from entry in points (plus small profit)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 筛选持仓的魔术编号，0表示管理所有持仓
parameters.description_en: Magic number for position filter, 0 means manage all

parameters.name: ApplyToAllSymbols
parameters.description: 是否应用于所有交易品种，false则仅当前图表品种
parameters.description_en: Apply to all symbols, false means current chart symbol only

pros: 简单实用，有效保护浮盈免受回撤损失
参数设置灵活，可调整触发点数和偏移量
支持魔术编号过滤，可与策略EA配合使用而不冲突
不自行开仓，风险极低，属于纯辅助管理工具
pros_en: Simple and practical, effectively protects floating profit from drawdown losses
Flexible parameter settings with adjustable trigger points and offset values
Supports MagicNumber filtering, can work alongside strategy EAs without conflict
Does not open trades independently, extremely low risk as a purely assistive management tool
cons: 仅提供保本功能，缺乏移动止损（追踪止损）等更高级的保护机制
没有可视化界面或信息面板，用户无法直观了解EA运行状态
缺乏日志记录功能，无法追溯保本操作的执行历史
保本后若行情继续有利，止损停留在保本位可能过早被止损出场
cons_en: Only provides breakeven functionality, lacks advanced protection mechanisms like trailing stop
No visual interface or information panel, users cannot intuitively monitor EA operation status
Lacks logging functionality, cannot trace the execution history of breakeven operations
After breakeven, if price continues favorably, the SL staying at breakeven may cause premature stop-out
improvements: 增加追踪止损功能，保本后可继续跟随价格移动止损以锁定更多利润
添加信息面板和操作日志，提升用户体验和可追溯性
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality so that after breakeven, SL can continue following price to lock in more profit
Add an information panel and operation logs to improve user experience and traceability

risk_points: 作为纯管理工具不涉及开仓风险，但保本偏移设置不当可能导致保本后仍被止损
若MagicNumber设为0可能误管理其他策略的持仓
risk_points_en: As a pure management tool it involves no opening risk, but improper breakeven offset settings may still result in stop-out after breakeven
Setting MagicNumber to 0 may inadvertently manage positions from other strategies

summary_en: This EA is a breakeven utility that automatically moves the stop loss of open positions to the breakeven point once price moves a specified number of points in profit. It does not open its own trades but manages existing positions to lock in risk-free trades.
